doc: Sound effects (M2-AUD-02; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). Audio.play_sfx(id) plays a row: files (one is picked per play, never the same twice running when there are several), bus (mix.json), volume_db (assets ship at their mix.md targets, so 0 unless a context needs it quieter), pitch_jitter (a fraction: each play is pitched within +- this), cooldown_ms (a play sooner than this after the last is dropped), voices (the most that sound at once; the oldest is cut). Rows named in other tables (battle_sfx.json, shrine_sfx.json, ui_sfx.json) must exist here; tools/validate_data.py checks every file.
